outcome: Kerz–Schmidt and Schmidt cover established compactification-independent tame categories under appropriate hypotheses. Numerical tameness for arbitrary normal compactifications must not be conflated with the log-regular theorem proved here. No novelty claim. Node character is proved from the local Kummer chart; no relevant exact branch-sign theorem was identified in these query results.
